column2: TESTING.md "Remotes" § Per breakpoint, Push box row: `Push main → origin/main`, the `1 commit · …` line, the `git push --progress …` command, `[ Cancel ]     Push`; no frame is drawn around the box, and the graph's `Comm` shows left of it — judge whether that reads as a box.
TESTING.md § Per breakpoint, Push box row: same lines, the graph and pane around it.

TESTING.md § Per breakpoint, Lease box row: same.

TESTING.md § Per breakpoint, Credential prompt (masked) row: same.

TESTING.md § Per breakpoint, Rejected sticky row: the same line.

TESTING.md § Per breakpoint, Journal row: three rows; push reads `not undoable — origin has it · <a> → …`; pull reads `1 ref · the index · the working tree ·← u` (`backup saved` is under the `← u` mark).

TESTING.md § Per breakpoint, Journal row: push `not undoable — origin has it · <a> → <b>`; pull `1 ref · the index · the working tree · backup saved  ← u`; fetch `remote-tracking refs · not undoable`.
TESTING.md § Per breakpoint, `u` after a push row: `undo: commit "ours" · origin/main still has it ✓`.
TESTING.md § Per breakpoint, `u` after a push row: same; the footer ends `S stash  H hide stash  f fetch  p pull  P push` (the remote hints need 156 columns).

Capture header "Judge by eye": password field shows only `•` per character (7 of them for "hunter2"), never the plaintext; username field shows the plaintext ("alice") — only password/token fields mask; box stays centred, borders intact, note row dimmed text present.

Capture header "Judge by eye": the box is centred over the screen, the title names the host (not the user), git's own question is on the first line, the field shows the masked count and no plaintext, the note says the answer is never stored, the footer says what ⏎, ⌃U and Esc do — Esc naming the push it cancels.

Capture header "Judge by eye": the lease box names the tip it expects and the one it sends, says it is refused if origin moved since the fetch, says whose history it rewrites, shows the exact git command, `[ Cancel ]` is under the cursor with `Force push` beside it; the footer while `f` runs shows the operation, git's own progress, and how to stop it (`esc cancels`).
